name: com.javienne.startup-diagnostics
description: Times the cold start of a game, from the start of the process to its first playable screen, on Android, iOS and in Play Mode. Measures it on a device from the editor, captures the Profiler of the start, diagnoses in the editor what weighs on it, and keeps one launch screen until the first playable screen. With an optimization guide and a tutorial.

samples.description: An interactive tutorial in the editor: the startup timeline, a measure on a device, its results, the diagnosis, what to shorten and a Profiler capture. Needs the Tutorial Framework (com.unity.learn.iet-framework 5.0 or later), to install first.
